provenance_note: Registry-native cohort: AACT search returned 640 asthma-biologic drug records; 26 trials posted an annualised-exacerbation rate ratio; 26 had a usable IRR + 95% CI (most-precise per trial, fail-closed on implausible IRR or degenerate CI). The effect measure is an incidence-RATE ratio (IRR), carried in the kit's ratio (publishedHR) slots because it shares the log-ratio forest math with a hazard ratio - it is labelled IRR throughout and is NOT a time-to-event HR. AACT-results-posted cohort, NOT a dual-screened systematic review. Synthesis hierarchy: Bayesian IRR league (asthma_league.json), tezepelumab lead; the engine flags the raw cross-agent ranking as baseline-rate / eosinophil effect modification (I^2 high), not a clean winner.
